metadata.description: 5-inch FPV quadcopter vehicle, for embedding in test models with a Model Reference block. Frame and 6-DOF body, four motor/propeller subsystems, 4S battery, IMU/magnetometer/barometer models, ground contact and a Betaflight-style flight controller (acro and angle modes, arming, Mahony and altitude estimators) at Tri-County Aerodrome (48TX), Texas. Input: sticks = [roll, pitch, yaw, throttle, AUX1 angle mode, AUX2 arm] (double[6], sticks -1..1, throttle 0..1, switches above 0.5 on). Outputs (Telemetry sheet): the true state, sensor readings, motor commands and speeds, rate setpoints, estimates and battery. Test models such as "FPV Demo Flight" drive it and check it with Assert blocks. Built by scripts/build-fpv-reference-model.ts; see docs/fpv-reference-model-plan.md.
